results.detail: The finding is framed as a bug ('באג העתק-הדבק'), which the standard forbids. It also says the code checks gencity_IsNull 'instead of' gencountry_IsNull, which asserts an intent that is not proven. The consequence is also stated too broadly. 'שינוי ארץ אינו מזוהה כשהעיר בקובץ ריקה' is not exact: when the city is empty, a change where one country value is NULL and the other is not is still detected (first operand gencountry_IsNull != Gencountrydb_IsNull). Only a change between two non-NULL country values is not detected. The code facts themselves (line 162) are correct.

results.id: L|Package\Foreach Loop Container\Create And Update Heir|detailed
results.detail: I re-derived all 23 units against the DTSX and the code, and they are correct, with two exceptions. (a) Unit [20] tech says 'התנאי בודק gencity_IsNull במקום gencountry_IsNull'. 'במקום' asserts an intended column, which is not proven and frames the code as a mistake; the standard forbids bug framing. Unit [17] says the same thing neutrally ('התנאי בשורה 162 בודק את העיר'), so this is only a wording issue in [20]. (b) Unit [5] gives the full name as 'שם פרטי, רווח ושם משפחה' and gives the NULL outcome only for status. The expression gen_firstname + " " + gen_lastname returns NULL if either part is NULL. The trim script sets an empty value to null; whether the column then becomes NULL is SSIS behaviour not shown in the files. If it does, Create Heir does not write gen_name (main.cs:150-151 if (!Row.genname_IsNull)). This is a missing nuance of a written value. Unit [14] 'כל השדות שיש להם ערך' covers it only implicitly. Everything else is verified: Heir has 12 columns with RedirectRow and Contact has 5 with FailComponent (RetainNulls=false). Merge Join is JoinType=2 (Inner), NumKeyColumns=3, TreatNullsAsEqual=true, and both Sorts have EliminateDuplicates=false. Status is (SUG_PEULA == "U" || SUG_PEULA == "C") ? 1 : 2, name/status errors are RedirectRow, and region is FailComponent. Append Zeros pads to the input column length, which is 9 (cachedLength=9, DTSX:3952-3953). Format Dates handles 8 and 6 characters, and the field size of 50 is ≥ 10. Contact lookup: contact.gen_identitynumber = gen_customeridentitynumber. Heir lookup uses 4 keys. Change empty strings to null maps TRIM == "" to NULL for 11 db columns. Create writes 16 attributes. Update writes the 12 attributes listed, and the date comparison is obj1.Date == obj2.AddHours(3).Date.
